Hey Ben,

Hope you’re well — we’re in the middle of procurement approval and the finance team flagged that we’re just shy of the token threshold needed to hit the FY end purchase window. Thanks —

Thanks for the heads-up and the usage file, that makes the case really clear. I can get a one-time 2,000,000 token allocation approved as a close incentive, subject to standard guardrails (90-day expiry, no retro refunds). I’m looping in Monica from CS so we can commit to a ramp plan and make sure the tokens get used efficiently.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — one-time top-up to clear procurement cutoff / Approval request

Team —

Brief: Hummingbyte (high-velocity platform team) will sign a 12-month committed contract if we provide a one-time 2,000,000 token uplift (no discount, token credit only) that expires in 90 days. They’ll issue a PO if we bridge them to the threshold.

Why it’s reasonable:
- Expected ARR from the 12-month contract: ~$145k ARR (multi-region).
- Usage profile shows a spike pattern for inference-heavy batch scoring in Q3 — small runway should convert.
- CS will run a 2-week onboarding sprint to accelerate adoption (Monica included).

Requesting: Finance sign-off to commit the one-time token credit and a short internal note to legal to accept the 90-day expiry clause. I attached an internal proposal that lays out tracking and clawback conditions.

Proposed guardrails:
- 2,000,000 token one-time credit
- 90-day expiration window
- Tokens applied on activation date (no retroactive redemption)
- If usage < 25% of allotted tokens at day 45, CS & AE to run a remediation plan; finance to consider partial recoupment if misuse is discovered.

Attachment: internal_proposal_2M_topup.pdf

Can you confirm today so I can reply to the customer?

— Ben
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance_ops@redwood.ai, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 16:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — one-time top-up to clear procurement cutoff / Approval request

Ben —

I’ve reviewed the proposal and the expected ARR math looks sound. Approve the 2,000,000 token uplift with the following conditions:
- Cap the uplift to tokens only (no cash discount).
- 90-day expiry is acceptable; set an automated expiry enforcement date in billing.
- Require a signed DocuSign acknowledging the one-time credit and that they accept the expiry and clawback terms.
- Finance wants an automated telemetry hook so we can review token consumption at day 30 and day 60.

I’ll loop legal to confirm any MA wording changes; if legal signs off by tomorrow, consider this green.

-Markus
